trigger.description: `ee focus suggest --task-frame <id> --recent-hours N` resolved a task frame that DOES carry memory-kind `evidence_links[]`, but none of those memories fall within the last N hours. Distinct from `task_frame_no_evidence` (frame is empty) and `no_recent_evidence` (no memories in window regardless of frame): here the window is non-empty AND the frame is non-empty, but the intersection is empty. The pipeline returns empty `recommendations[]` honoring the explicit scope, and emits this degraded entry so the caller can distinguish the three failure modes and choose the right repair.
setup_commands: ee remember "unrelated recent note" --workspace . --level episodic --kind fact --json
